Portfolio thesis
Customer retention is the story.

Bonney Hold Co operates four service-trade brands across northern California. The portfolio generated $73.4M in completed revenue across 77,004 jobs in the trailing 12 months, with Bonney accounting for 53% of revenue and Peter Levi another 30%. Of the 54,862 customers who placed a completed job in the trailing 36 months, 57% placed more than one. The portfolio added 18,641 new customers in the same L12M window, against a 150K-strong existing customer file.

California ZIPs inside the metros Bonney already operates in, where the median home value (Zillow ZHVI, Mar 2026) is above $600K and Bonney has fewer than 50 completed jobs in the trailing 36 months. Sorted by ZHVI descending. Atherton, Portola Valley, and Hillsborough lead the list. Demographic columns from U.S. Census ACS 2019-2023 5-year estimates.
